name: break-stmt-test-fef9973703/break-stmt-negative-e.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: 'Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported'; ballerina/lang.array lists length, push, map, indexOf, remove, removeAll, toStream, toBase64, toBase16, fromBase64, fromBase16, but not forEach.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: 'Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:'; array:forEach is absent.
reason: The whole negative case includes intArr.forEach with an anonymous callback containing an illegal break. Array forEach is outside both the supported lang.array methods and langlib method-call list, making this a feature case even though break rejection itself is within supported statements.
unsupported_constructs: Array langlib forEach invocation via intArr.forEach(...)
test_design_notes: The three @error markers assert rejection of a break outside a loop, unreachable code after break, and a callback break that cannot target the enclosing foreach.
